diversity_evidence: All ten stories share the same flooded grain-store emergency, Ren's wrongful blame and clearing, bent retaining pin, partial rescue of twenty-four sacks, and identical flooded-step ending. s000017 and s000019 add a successful sluice test, while s000014 and s000002 use incomplete reading and s000028, s000038, s000023, s000021, s000037, and s000024 use an inaccessible diagram; these are minor route variations within one plot.

plot_groups.summary: A jammed mill gate threatens winter grain; Ida clears newcomer Ren of blame but lacks either instructions or enough safe help to repair it, so the group saves some sacks while the flood spoils the rest.
